I'm excited to share that I'm open to new opportunities as a Senior Data Engineer or Data Platform Lead in the healthcare and biotech industry. With my experience in designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, I'm confident in my ability to drive impact in this space.

Recently, I've been working with Delta Live Tables (DLT) pipelines, leveraging the power of declarative ETL to simplify and accelerate data processing. By defining pipelines using PIPL (Pipeline Interface Protocol Language) and configuring them with `dlt create` and `dlt update` commands, I've seen significant improvements in data quality and processing efficiency. I've also integrated DLT with Apache Spark and Delta Lake, utilizing `spark.sql` and `DeltaTable` APIs to build robust and performant pipelines.

In my current role, I've successfully implemented DLT pipelines to process large-scale datasets, reducing ETL runtime by 40% and improving data freshness. I'm eager to bring this expertise to a new challenge and collaborate with like-minded professionals in the healthcare and biotech industry.

If you're looking for a seasoned data engineer who can drive innovation and excellence in data platform design, let's connect and explore opportunities. Feel free to share this post with your network, and let's start a conversation!
